question: A uniform circular coil of mass $M$ and radius $R$ carries a current $I$. It is free to rotate about a fixed vertical diameter. A uniform horizontal magnetic field $B$ exists in the region. Initially, the coil is in unstable equilibrium (magnetic moment anti-parallel to B). It is slightly displaced and released. Calculate its angular velocity $\omega$ when it passes through the stable equilibrium position.
